name: ai-daily-news
title_zh: AI 新闻 RSS 进来，分类摘要和苹果风网页出去
tagline_zh: 每天刷 smol.ai 的 AI 新闻太碎？它替你抓取、摘要、按日期分类，还能一键生成带分享图的苹果风网页。
tagline_en: Tired of scattered AI news? It fetches, summarizes, and sorts smol.ai RSS by date, then optionally renders an.
desc_en: Fetches AI news from smol.ai RSS and generates structured markdown with intelligent summarization and categorization. Optionally creates beautiful HTML webpages with Apple-style themes and shareable card images. Use when user asks about AI news, daily tech updates, or wants news organized by date or category.
why_zh: 不是简单转存 RSS，而是先做智能摘要再归类，输出结构化 Markdown。
why_en: It doesn't just dump RSS—it summarizes and categorizes into structured Markdown first, then optionally builds themed HTML with.
limit_zh: 只认 smol.ai 这一个 RSS 源，换源得改代码；摘要质量依赖模型能力，本地无 LLM 时只做抓取和分类。
limit_en: Hardcoded to smol.ai RSS only; swapping sources needs code edits. Summaries rely on an LLM—without one, it only fetches and sorts. HTML output is a.
title_en: AI news RSS in, categorized digest & Apple-style page out
